work.composition: tripartite horizontal zones unified by vertical ribbons
work.description: Large-format mixed-media panel divided into three horizontal registers: red plastic-wrapped rectangles at top, a white central zone bearing multiple compact discs arranged symmetrically around a vertical axis, and a black lower register with red and green ribbon stripes. Vertical green and red ribbon bands unify all three zones.
work.title: Untitled (CD Formation Panel)
